versions.content: If the Init block callback returns a value different than E_OK and the block has no default data configured then the request result shall be set to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK. Note: The Init block callback is called either if a read request for a block failed in retrieving the data from the non - volatile memory or if explicit default data recovery is requested. Either way, NvM will attempt to retrieve the default data for the block and then call the init callback. If the block has no default data and the Init block callback does not indicate E_OK, the read/restore defauls operation has failed completely and the request result needs to reflect this.
